events.title: The Dragon Covenant
events.summary: Welcome, one and all! As the sun rises high over October, the month of the righteous Libra, the time is right to bring you some insight into the Zodiac Legion’s mortal enemy, and your primary opposing force in the game. Centuries ago, during the previous awakening of magic, some sought to harness the power of the stars for evil. These wicked sorcerers forged an alliance known as the Dragon Covenant, and their sole desire in this world was to enslave all to their bidding. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32597

events.title: What's new in Zodiac Legion: 2026 video edition
events.summary: Greetings, noble knights. Steam Next Fest starts on October 19, and the updated Zodiac Legion demo is already playable. Here is a 30-minute Let's Play covering the new campaign and combat mechanics: research, construction, roster management, the world map, and tactical combat (support, traps, movement checks). If you are already familiar with some parts of the game, you can use the chapters on YouTube to jump straight to the part that interests you. May the stars watch over you!

events.title: Ascension and level up fixes
events.summary: Greetings commanders, Our astrologer monks have been hard at work fixing a few issues in the latest demo build: - Fixed ascension UI now allowing inscription - Fixed the recall party button being hidden - Added a few tooltips - Fixed some signs starting with "legacy" stat runes or abilities. - Fixed ascension stat bonus being removed on loading a game. - Fixed enemy strength being too low early on - Fixed enemy AI soldiers not acting the first turn they are discovered.

events.title: Under the sign of Virgo: An experimental demo build for the Turn Based RPG fest
events.summary: Welcome, noble friends! For Steam's Party-Based RPG Fest we open the gates of the Zodiac Citadel a little early. This demo runs on our experimental branch: new champion powers, a campaign that now is closer to our vision, with research and recovery between missions, and the speed controls you asked for. Expect rough edges, malfunctioning skills and the occasional collapse. Your reports will be thoroughly studied by our astrologer monks. May the stars guide your blades. Six months of updates Marc

events.title: Lords, Stars and Shadows: The Strategic Layer of Zodiac Legion
events.summary: Welcome, noble friends! June is the month of the diplomatic Gemini, so what better time to bring you an update about the strategic layer of Zodiac Legion? Grab some lordly refreshments and read on, as we bring you new details on managing your domain, engaging with neutral factions and pushing back against your wicked enemy. events.title: Minor menu fixes
events.summary: Greetings commanders, This small hotfix remeides a few menu navigation issues, during and after missions. - Fixed the Back button in the settings menu being unavailable during standalone and tutorial missions - Added a "Quit Game" option in the settings menu during missions, allowing you to return to the main menu without closing the game. Until we meet again.

events.title: Medieval Festival demo update
events.summary: Greetings, commanders, For the medieval festival, we made a few improvements to the demo: Stronghold Building Node-Based Construction: Buildings now require "Nodes" (a strategic resource earned through "capture lodestone" missions) to construct. Note that most of the building perks are still inactive. Localization Support Languages Added: Added French language support. Future Proofing: Implemented a system to support further languages in the future, including those using different character sets

events.title: UI delay and map hotfix
events.summary: Greetings commanders, The latest hotfix addresses the following issues: - UI delay was not applied correctly (the pathing calculations would start on moving to a new tile anyway, crippling the FPS on mouse move) - various map plots have been fixed, others have been added - fixed alignment issues on some map layers

events.title: Build 0.40 hotfix 2: full screen
events.summary: Greetings commanders, Some of you have complained about the mouse cursor not working properly in fullscreen. It is just a minor engine update to make fullscreen more responsive. The cursor should also be locked to the window in fullscreen mode, now.

events.title: Hotfix for No Time to Loot demo build (0.4)
events.summary: Greetings commanders, I messed up the build settings and it was shipped with logging of all Los calculations, resulting in a severe performance hit. It should be fixed now. Sorry for the inconvenience.
